data.title: Published<H>: tie daemon volatile records to a publication receipt (bn-283p6)

data.body: [HIGH] Preserve receipt-validation failures as typed startup outcomes. These `.ok()` calls erase identity derivation and `RecordDefect::Unreceipted` failures. The final arm then stores the unchanged `ResolvedTask`, whose resolution still says `Restored` or `Terminal`, although no live task was restored. `verification.start` treats those resolved variants as unreachable, falls through, and can run a fresh task under the same identity. A restart with a different configured identity seam triggers the continuation path without store corruption. A missing ledger receipt triggers both parked and terminal paths. Failure modes: identity-seam drift, missing or damaged receipt entries, and any later restore defect become silent non-restoration. Edge cases: parked and terminal tasks both take this path; normal exact-seam recovery remains valid. Rollback: revert this commit, or preserve the selected store handle and convert every restore error into a typed failed or unattributed resolution before merge. Monitoring: none currently sees the cause because `.ok()` discards it; expose `Unreceipted` in startup resolution and alert on it. Validation: add restart tests for a mismatched identity seam and missing campaign or continuation receipts, and require a typed failure with no rerun. This static BLOCK does not satisfy or replace the separate `risk:critical` human-approval gate.

data.reason: [HIGH] Startup discards receipt-validation failures and retains a false Restored or Terminal resolution, permitting silent task rerun instead of a typed recovery failure. See crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:1083-1107.

data.body: Fixed in 24b8512. The pass keeps the index identity of the selected continuation/terminal record and ties receipts under it (no re-derivation by the successor's seam). recovery::confirm_receipts withdraws any unrestorable Restored/Terminal to typed Failed(Unreceipted), shown in the startup report. Startup files a failed restore the same way. verification.start answers a Restored/Terminal with no live task on the resolved lane and never runs it afresh. Regressions in gate_g1_08_acceptance.rs §E: changed seam (parked, terminal), missing receipt (parked, terminal), planted stale restoration not rerun (both paths).
